Hi everyone is me again . 
I am from Kosovo and my husband is Israeli.
We had civil marriage in 2020 the marriage is registered in kosovo in israel too .
I had applied for family Reunification in october 2025 and since then I am in tourist visas. We been talking regarding our documents and had uploaded one by one with apostile as it is requested. 2 weeks ago they told me that they will extend my tourist visa one more time for 3 months but I have 2 documents they are not approving, document from archive that I havent been married before this marriage and the criminal record, they asked me to take the original certificates , stamp them with apostille notarise and translate in the same place then apostille again for the notarised person . I tried all these months to do so , turned out my country has a law that the translate and notary should be different from each other , I went in jerusalem in Embassy of Kosovo and asked them what to do , they told me you should take the documents send them to official court translator and then stamp them with apostille from ministry of foreign affairs , thats what I did. Next day I went again in Misrad Hapnim in Herzliya branch and I told them this is how it should be otherwise it cant be done my country doesnt have translator and notary in same place , more official it cant be than giving translator from Court and apostille for him from ministry of foreign affairs. They said Okay maybe you are right kosovo is new country for us and maybe we dont know how is the procedure correctly, ( they said to me the moment you give us these documents and they get approved we will give you B1 visa , I dont think is accurate too because I am not applying to give a partner in israel I am already here , I am married for 6 years and applying for family reunification) . Today after 10 days waiting I received an email that the document hasnt passed , it needs to be notarised!!! But they said we will check with the expertise regarding this!!! I really dont know what to do anymore ! 
Any advise would help . 
Thank you 🙏🏼
